items.name: Gdańska Liga Speedcubingu III 2025
items.information:
Gdańska Liga Speedcubingu to speedcuberska inicjatywa z najdłuższymi tradycjami i niezwykłą historią. Od 2008 roku w różnych lokalizacjach nasze wspaniałe miasto gościło ponad 60 turniejów w oficjalnej formule World Cube Association, w, których łącznie wzięło udział kilka tysięcy zawodników z całego kraju.

---

Gdańsk Speedcubing League is an speedcubing initiative with long tradition and extraordinary history. Since 2008 in several different locations our city hosted more than 60 official WCA competitions, where few thousands of competitors could have done their attempts.

### Speedcubing returns to O'ahu with another WCA competition, this time on the Windward Side!

* It is recommended you register as soon as possible to save a spot.
* Be sure to familiarize yourself with the WCA regulations. If this is your first official competition, [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8) will provide you with most of the information you need.
* If you are a first time competitor it is highly encouraged to be present for the competitor tutorial at 1:00 PM.

---

#### This competition will take place over the course of two days!
Please note that this competition will span more than one day. You are not required to attend both days of the competition if you are only competing in one day.

**Saturday Events:** 3x3, 2x2, 4x4, Pyraminx, Skewb
**Sunday Events:** 7x7, 3x3 Blindfolded, Clock, Megaminx, 3x3 MultiBlind

---

#### This competition will also be part of [WCC Western FMC Championship 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WCCWesternFMCChampionship2025)! For more information, please visit the [Fewest Moves tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KailuaKupulau2025#56089-fewest-moves).

### PORTUGUÊS ###

Sejam bem-vindos ao Rio Cubolympics 2025!
Será um prazer recebê-los.

**VEJA AS ATUALIZAÇÕES DA COMPETIÇÃO NO NOSSO INSTAGRAM**
**@riocubolympics**

Dicas:
	- Chegue ao local da competição pelo menos 30 minutos antes de modalidade que participará;
	- O cubo que você irá competir deve estar em bom estado;
	- Você é responsável pelo seu cubo e seus pertences, cuide deles. Não nos responsabilizamos por perda de cubos mágicos e outros pertences durante a competição;
	- Se tiver alguma dúvida, não hesite em perguntar para a equipe de organização e delegados.

Mesmo que a nossa competição seja formada por alguns competidores experientes, sempre teremos espaço para novos cubistas.
Procure se divertir bastante!

### ENGLISH ###

Welcome to Rio Cubolympics 2025!
It will be a pleasure to welcome you.

**SEE THE UPDATES OF THE COMPETITIONS ON OUR INSTAGRAM**
**@riocubolympics**

Tips:
	- Arrive at the competition location at least 30 minutes before the category you will participate in;
	- The cube you will compete with must be in good condition;
	- You are responsible for your cube and your belongings, take care of them. We are not responsible for the loss of cubes and other belongings during the competition;
	- If you have any questions, don't hesitate to ask the organization team and delegates.

Even though our competition is made up of some experienced competitors, we will always have room for new cubers.
Have a lot of fun!

items.information:

### **Registrants will be accepted in the order that they pay, not the order that they register. Please be patient with us as we manually accept all eligible competitors.**

**Competition Day Timing**
- The competition will begin at the scheduled start time.
- Lunch will end at the scheduled time. 
- Events will begin as soon as the previous event is wrapping up. Exception: All First Round events will not start more than 20 minutes early. 
- Competitors may not compete in an event if they miss last call for that event. In general, last call is a few minutes after the last group is called.

##### Español
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
¡Bienvenidos a **444 Puebla 2025**!

Puebla, la Ciudad de los Ángeles, y Wars Cube están listos para recibirte en esta emocionante competencia. Ven y celebra con nosotros el 4.º aniversario de Wars Cube en su 4.º torneo organizado para el Día del Niño, en el 4.º mes del año. Y, por supuesto, ya sabes cuál será nuestra categoría principal.

**¿Aceptas el reto?**

Esta competencia es posible gracias al apoyo del **[Instituto Municipal del Deporte de Puebla](https://imd.pueblacapital.gob.mx/)**.

444 Puebla 2025 es una competencia oficial de la WCA, por lo que todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados con el [Reglamento](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/).

​
##### English
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Welcome to **444 Puebla 2025**!

Puebla, the City of Angels, and Wars Cube are ready to welcome you to this exciting competition. Come and celebrate with us the 4th anniversary of Wars Cube at its 4th tournament organized for Children's Day, in the 4th month of the year. And, of course, you already know what our main category will be.

**Do you accept the challenge?**

This competition is made possible thanks to the support of the **[Instituto Municipal del Deporte de Puebla](https://imd.pueblacapital.gob.mx/)**.

444 Puebla 2025 is an official WCA competition, so all competitors must be familiar with the [Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations).

items.information:
#Please check the schedule to find possible time slots.  Please indicate in the registration comments what timeslot you would prefer to compete in.
#Competitors may register for 3x3 and up to one of the following events: 2x2, Skewb, Pyraminx, Megaminx, Clock, or Square-1.  Competitors may not register for more than two events, and if they register for two events, one of them must be 3x3.

- On-site registration will be the expo's $30 entrance fee plus $5 paid to us on the spot.
- Specify the time you would prefer to compete in the registration comments.  We will email everyone their time slot once registration has closed.  Time slots will be determined based on a first-come first-serve basis.  If your desired time slot is full, we will reach out via email and ask for another time slot.

Welcome to Nevada Championship 2025! The first ever state championship held in Nevada!
The competition is open to all, but only Nevada residents are eligible for state champion titles. See NV Champion Eligibility for more info.

* Registrants will be accepted in the order that they pay, not the order that they register. Please be patient with us as we manually accept all eligible competitors.


**Competition Day Timing**
- The competition will begin at the scheduled start time.
- Events will begin as soon as the previous event is wrapping up. Exception: All First Round events will not start more than 20 minutes early. 
- Competitors may not compete in an event if they miss last call for that event. In general, last call is a few minutes after the last group is called.


#### **How to Withdraw/Alter Registration**
Registered competitors withdraw/alter their registration by emailing the organisation team (unrcubing@gmail.com) the following:
1. Statement of intent to withdraw/alter registration.
2. Changes to registration (if applicable).
3. Name (and WCA ID, if applicable) of the competitor.


#### **Staff Member Registration**
Competition staff members are hand-selected by the organisation team and will be offered a refunded registration fee in exchange for their service to the cubing community for the entire duration of the competition. 
For this competition all staff members must fill out the form in the Staff Applications tab. If you do not fill out this form you will not be able to staff this competition.

items.information:
🇧🇷 **Português**

** Bem-vindos à primeira competição de Cubo Mágico do Planalto Médio do Rio Grande do Sul !!!! **
Localizada no norte do Estado do Rio Grande do Sul, na região conhecida como Planalto Médio, a cidade de Passo Fundo destaca-se pela representatividade nas áreas médica, cultural, educacional, agrícola de precisão e tecnológica.
Por estar localizada numa região estratégica do Rio Grande do Sul e próxima do centro e oeste de Santa Catarina, o Passo Fundo Cubing 2025 promete a inserção do Cubo Mágico em um espaço pouco alcançado até o momento, trazendo a promessa de crescimento do esporte numa verdadeira expansão para os atletas que buscam as possibilidades de participação nos campeonatos oficiais. 
Agora chegou a vez de Passo Fundo alcançar a representatividade também no Esporte para o Cérebro! 
Divulgar esse esporte em nível oficial, e levar aos competidores a oportunidade de participação, é o objetivo solidário da organização e dos apoiadores, especialmente da Secretaria Municipal de Educação e da Prefeitura Municipal de Passo Fundo, que apoiam o evento!
Nos vemos lá!

🇬🇧 **English:**

** Welcome to the first speedcubing competition in Passo Fundo - Rio Grande do Sul !!!! **
Located in the north of the state of Rio Grande do Sul, in the region known as "middle plateau", the city of Passo Fundo stands out due to its representation in medical, cultural, educational, precision farming and technology areas.
Since it is located in a strategical region in Rio Grande do Sul and close to the center and West of the state of Santa Catarina, this competition is a certain path to introducing speedcubing somewhere not fully reached yet, with the promise of growth to the sport, bringing a chace of participating in official competitions.
Now it is Passo Fundo's turn to reach its representation in the mind sport  too!
Spreading this sport officially and taking the opportunity to the competitors are the objectives of the organisers and supporters, especially of Secretaria Municipal de Educação and of Prefeitura Municipal de Passo Fundo, who support the event!
We will meet there!

This is the 8th installment of WCA Rubik's Cube Competition in Baguio City!
This time, the competition is participating in the official WCA Newcomer Month 2025. The registration process will reserve 50% of spots for new competitors. New competitors are considered to have no WCA ID or a WCA ID with 2025. Returning competitors are considered to have a WCA ID that is from 2024 or earlier. All competitors must still follow all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete.

Registrations will be accepted based on the following:
● 50% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are reserved for new competitors.
● Initially, 50% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are available for returning competitors on a first come, first serve basis.
● If greater than 50% of new competitors register before 50% of spots are filled by returning competitors, any additional new competitors will be accepted on a first come, first serve basis alongside returning competitors.
● If the spots reserved for new competitors are not filled by new competitors before registration closes two weeks prior to the competition, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors.

# **REGISTRATION**
The registration fee is good for **ALL EVENTS/PUZZLES** of your choice.

Early registration is from February 15 to March 25 at Php 250.00 for Kiddie Division (4-11 years old) and Php 350.00 for Open Division.
Late registration is from March 26 to 29 (before 3x3x3 R1 starts) at Php 350.00 (Kiddie Division) and Php 450.00 for Open Division. 

To register, use the WCA website and follow the payment details **if you are a returning competitor**. **If you are a newcomer**, please contact Xavier De Vera at 09461564040 for the details.

Payment Method:
Slots are secured via payment-first system. You may pay for your registration fees via:

**GCash Express Send**
Account Name: Xavier De Vera
Account Number: 0946 156 4040

** PLEASE indicate the NAME OF THE COMPETITOR in message/note tab in GCash app before sending payment. You can also send the proof of payment to xprestousa.27@gmail.com. Failing to do so might revoke your registration.

items.information:
##### *English version is below*

#### **Deutsch:**

Nach einem erfolgreichem Fasching Turnier im letzten Jahr, dürfen wir auch dieses Jahr wieder Vienna Fasching 2025 als offizelles WCA Turnier ankündigen.

Die Speedcubing Competition wird organisiert von David Dinh und Jeremia Neuhold und delegiert von Viktor Kalmar, Pranjal Khan und Florian Truckenthanner. Diesmal findet die Competition im Jugendgästehaus Brigittenau statt. Die Resultate dieser Competition werden zu den offiziellen WCA World Rankings hinzugefügt.

Jeder ist bei diesem Turnier gerne willkommen, unabhängig von der Erfahrung, Alter oder sonstigen Fähigkeiten. Manche Events haben ein spezifisches Zeitlimit, damit wir sicherstellen können den ganzen Tag über im Zeitplan zu bleiben. Es dürfen Puzzles jeder Marke verwendet werden solange sie den WCA Richtlinien entsprechen. Es sind alle Herzlich willkommen!

Jeder Teilnehmer darf einen Gast mitbringen.


Wir freuen uns besonders auf neue Speedcuber aus Österreich!

-----

#### **English:**

After a successful Fasching Competition last year, we are once again happy to announce Vienna Fasching 2024 as an official WCA Competition.

The speedcubing competition is organised by David Dinh and Jeremia Neuhold and delegated by Viktor Kalmar, Pranjal Khan and Florian Truckenthanner. Results of the competition will be added to the official WCA World Rankings.

The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors must be familiar with the WCA Regulations. Any puzzle brand may be used during the competition, as long as it complies with the WCA regulations.

Every Competitor can bring one guest.

# Engels
This competition is participating in the official WCA Newcomer Month 2025. The registration process will reserve 25% of spots for new competitors. New competitors are considered to have no WCA ID or a WCA ID with 2025. Returning competitors are considered to have a WCA ID that is from 2024 or earlier. All competitors must still follow all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete.

Registrations will be accepted based on the following:

25% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are reserved for new competitors.
Initially, 75% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are available for returning competitors on a first come, first serve basis.
If greater than 25% of new competitors register before 75% of spots are filled by returning competitors, any additional new competitors will be accepted on a first come, first serve basis alongside returning competitors.
If the spots reserved for new competitors are not filled by new competitors before registration closes two weeks prior to the competition, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors.
  
See the "Newcomers" tab.  

# Nederlands
Deze wedstrijd doet mee met de officiële WCA Newcomer Month 2025. Tijdens de inschrijving wordt 25% van de competitor limit gereserveerd voor nieuwkomers. Nieuwkomers zijn iedereen zonder WCA ID en WCA ID met 2025. Terugkerende deelnemers zijn iedereen met een 2024 WCA ID en eerder. Alle deelnemers moeten daarnaast ook voldoen aan alle andere inschrijfeisen om de inschrijving te laten tellen.

Inschrijvingen worden als volgt geaccepteerd:

25% van de competitor limit is gereserveerd voor nieuwkomers. De andere 75% voor terugkerende deelnemers gaat op volgorde van WCA inschrijving. 
Als meer dan 25% nieuwkomers inschrijven, voordat de overige 75% vol zit gaan zowel de nieuwkomers als de terugkerende deelnemers op volgorde van WCA inschrijving samen met de terugkomende deelnemers. 
Als de 25% van de competitor limit die gereserveerd is voor nieuwkomers niet vol raakt twee weken voordat de inschrijving dicht gaat, dan komen deze plekken beschikbaar voor zowel nieuwkomers als terugkerende deelnemers.

Zie tabblad "Nieuwkomersactie"

items.name: CubeCo Coastal Cubing KZN 2025
items.information:
**Durban’s First 2-Day Cubing Competition in Over Two Years!**

Join us for an action-packed weekend of speedcubing on March 21st & 22nd!

Day 1 (Friday) falls on Human Rights Day, making it the perfect opportunity to challenge yourself with events you don't always see - like Clock, Megaminx, and even 3x3 Blindfolded! If you're looking to try something new, this is your chance.

Day 2 (Saturday) is all about the fan favorites: Pyraminx, 2x2, and a full three rounds of 3x3. Whether you're a seasoned competitor or brand new to WCA events, there's something for you.

New to competing? No problem! We'll have a newcomer tutorial to walk you through competing and judging (yes, even first-timers help with judging). Just remember to bring a form of ID for registration. While most beginner-friendly events happen on Saturday, you're absolutely welcome to compete on Friday too!

Don't miss out - come test your skills, meet fellow cubers, and be part of Durban's cubing community!

# Português
Esta competição está participando do Mês Oficial do Novato da WCA 2025. O processo de inscrição reservará 50% das vagas para novatos. Novatos são considerados como não tendo ID da WCA ou um ID da WCA com 2025. Os competidores veteranos são considerados como tendo um ID da WCA de 2024 ou anterior. Todos os competidores ainda devem seguir todos os requisitos de inscrição para que sua inscrição seja considerada completa.

As inscrições serão aceitas com base nos seguintes critérios:
* 50% das vagas (30 vagas) são inicialmente reservadas para competidores novatos.
* 50% das vagas (30 vagas) estarão disponíveis para competidores veteranos, por ordem de chegada.
* Se mais de 30 competidores novatos se inscreverem antes que 60 vagas sejam preenchidas por competidores veteranos, quaisquer novatos adicionais serão aceitos por ordem de chegada, juntamente com os competidores veteranos.
* Se as 30 vagas reservadas para novatos não forem preenchidas por novatos duas semanas antes da competição (até dia 2 de Março de 2025), as vagas restantes, até o limite de competidores, serão aceitas de competidores veteranos.

Atenção: Esta competição terá limite de competitores. Inscreva-se somente se você tem certeza que irá participar.
Em caso de desistência, por favor entrar em contato com o delegado ([bdamacena@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:bdamacena@worldcubeassociation.org)). 50% da taxa de inscrição será reembolsada se o competidor desistir até 9 de março de 2025.

As inscrições deverão ser pagas antecipadamente via PIX: [bdamacena@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:bdamacena@worldcubeassociation.org).

Enviar o comprovante do pagamento, junto com o nome do competidor, para o email: [bdamacena@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:bdamacena@worldcubeassociation.org).
A inscrição só será confirmada no site da WCA após confirmação do pagamento.

Por favor leia o [Regulamento da WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian/) antes da competição.

# English

New competitors are considered to have no WCA ID or a WCA ID with 2025. Returning competitors are considered to have a WCA ID that is from 2024 or earlier. All competitors must still follow all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete.

Registrations will be accepted based on the following:
* 50% of spots (30 spots) are initially reserved for new competitors.
* 50% of spots (30 spots) are initially are available for returning competitors on a first come, first serve basis.
* If more than 30 new competitors register before 60 spots are filled by returning competitors, any additional new competitors will be accepted on a first come, first serve basis alongside returning competitors.
* If the 30 spots reserved for new competitors are not filled by new competitors two weeks prior to the competition (until March 2nd 2025), remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors.

Attention: This competition has a limit on competitors. Only sign up if you are sure you will participate.
In case of withdrawal, please contact the delegate ([bdamacena@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:bdamacena@worldcubeassociation.org)). 50% of the register fee will be refunded if the competitor withdraw up until March 9 2025. 

Entries must be paid in advance via PIX: [bdamacena@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:bdamacena@worldcubeassociation.org).

Send proof of payment, along with the competitor's name, to the email: [bdamacena@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:bdamacena@worldcubeassociation.org).
Registration will only be confirmed on the WCA website after confirmation of payment.

Please read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition.

items.name: Rahn Education Open 2025
items.information:
**Deutsch**

Herzlich Willkommen zur **Rahn Education Open 2025** in Leipzig
Nach den ersten beiden Competitions 2023 und 2024 sowie den Rubik's German Nationals 2024 können wir **Leipzig** nun zu einem etablierten Cubing-Standort zählen. Wir, das Orga-Team, freuen uns auf euer zahlreiches Erscheinen. Euch erwartet wieder eine schöne Venue in perfekter zentraler Lage in Leipzig, ein motiviertes Orga-Team und vieles mehr. 

Diese Ausgabe der **Rahn Education Open** im Rahmen des offiziellen WCA Newcomer Month richtet sich an neue und unerfahrene Cuber. Bei der Anmeldung werden deshalb 43,75% der Plätze für neue Teilnehmende reserviert. Als neue Teilnehmende gelten Teilnehmende ohne WCA-ID oder mit einer WCA-ID aus dem Jahr 2025. Wiederkehrende Teilnehmende haben eine WCA-ID, die aus dem Jahr 2024 oder früher stammt. Alle Teilnehmenden müssen weiterhin alle Registrierungsanforderungen erfüllen, damit ihre Registrierung als vollständig gilt. Weitere Informationen zur Annahme der Anmeldungen findet ihr im Tab "Newcomer Month".

**Bitte lies dir alle Tabs sorgfältig durch, damit du mit dem Ablaufplan und allen Modalitäten vertraut bist.**


**English**

Welcome to the **Rahn Education Open 2025** in Leipzig
After the first two competitions in 2023 and 2024 and the Rubik's German Nationals 2024, we can now count **Leipzig** as an established cubing location. We, the organizing team, are looking forward to your numerous appearances. Once again, you can expect a beautiful venue in a perfect central location in Leipzig, a motivated organizing team and much more. 

This edition of the **Rahn Education Open** as part of the official WCA Newcomer Month is aimed at new and inexperienced cubers. When registering, 43.75% of the places will therefore be reserved for new participants. Participants without a WCA ID or with a WCA ID from the year 2025 are considered new participants. Returning participants have a WCA ID from the year 2024 or earlier. All participants must continue to fulfill all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete. You can find more information on how registrations are accepted in the “Newcomer Month” tab.

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NTYzNTAsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--3108208eb7baaec4005983963bd4455293cbb240/1000049076.png)

### ČEŠTINA
Tato soutěž se účastní oficiálního Měsíce nováčků WCA 2025. Při registraci bude 50 % míst vyhrazeno pro nováčky. Za nováčky se považují ti, kteří ještě na své první WCA soutěži nebyli, nebo na ní byli v roce 2025 (nemají WCA ID, nebo mají WCA ID s rokem 2025). Za vracející se soutěžící se považujeme ty, kteří mají WCA ID s rokem 2024 a méně. Všichni soutěžící musí i nadále dodržet všechny registrační požadavky, aby jejich registrace byla považována za kompletní.

Registrace budou přijímány na základě následujících kritérií:

* 50 % míst je vyhrazeno pro nové soutěžící.
* Na zbylých 50 % míst budou přijati vracející se soutěžící podle pořadí přihlášení.
* Po obsazení vyhrazené kapacity pro nováčky budou na zbývající místa přijímáni jak vracející se soutěžící, tak nováčci, podle pořadí přihlášení.
* Nebude-li vyhrazená kapacita pro nováčky naplněna 2 týdny před začátkem soutěže, budou na tato místa přijímáni i vracející se soutěžící, dle pořadí registrace.

#### **Pódium pro nováčky** 
S potěšením oznamujeme, že v kategorii 3x3x3 budeme vyhlašovat pódium pro nové soutěžící. 


### ENGLISH
This competition is participating in the official WCA Newcomer Month 2025. The registration process will reserve 50 % of spots for new competitors. New competitors are considered to have no WCA ID or a WCA ID with 2025. Returning competitors are considered to have a WCA ID that is from 2024 or earlier. All competitors must still follow all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete.

Registrations will be accepted based on the following:

* 50 % of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are reserved for new competitors.
* Initially, 50 % of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are available for returning competitors on a first come, first serve basis.
* If greater than 50 % of new competitors register before 50 % of spots are filled by returning competitors, any additional new competitors will be accepted on a first come, first serve basis alongside returning competitors.
* If the spots reserved for new competitors are not filled by new competitors before registration closes two weeks prior to the competition, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors.

#### **Newcomer podium** 
We are excited to announce that special podium awards will be presented to newcomers in the 3x3x3 event.

Será um prazer recebê-los e temos algumas dicas para vocês, competidores e acompanhantes:
- Chegue ao local da competição 20 minutos antes de modalidade que participará;
- O cubo que você irá competir deve estar em bom estado, portanto, cuide bem dele;

- Arrive at the competition 20 minutes before the modality that you will participate;

items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NTQ1NTAsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--c770014c6db789e76c32778326e0f6980f437a47/466472712_1925266651296844_7482586112726949324_n.jpg)

Το Trikala Open 2025 θα είναι o πρωτος επίσημος διαγωνισμός της Ελλάδας για το 2025 στην πανέμορφη και υπερσύγχρονη πόλη των Τρικάλων! Στο αμφιθεατρικά χτισμένο ξενοδοχείο Ananti Resort & Spa, σε αίθουσα με πανοραμική θέα στην πόλη, θα διαγωνιστούν για 2 μέρες παλιοί και νέοι, μικροί και μεγάλοι Cubers απ´ όλη τη χώρα και όχι μόνο.
Πάρτε τους κύβους σας, ετοιμαστείτε, διαβάστε τους κανόνες και ελάτε σε μια ακόμα γιορτή του cubing!

Παρακαλoύμε διαβάστε αναλυτικά τις επόμενες σελίδες για να βρείτε όλες τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες. 

Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείται ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί το registration στη σελίδα του διαγωνισμού στην WCA **KAI** να γίνει και η πληρωμή του αντιτίμου συμμετοχής με χρήση της τραπεζικής σας κάρτας μέσω της πλατφόρμας πληρωμών stripe που χρησιμοποιεί η WCA, όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα. 

Δείτε αυτά τα βίντεο για να είστε έτοιμοι:

[Εγγραφή στη WCA, σε επίσημο διαγωνισμό και πολλά ακόμα. Οδηγός για πρωτάρηδες.](https://youtu.be/RS768gK0Vrg)

[Πώς να είσαι κριτής σε διαγωνισμό κύβων.](https://youtu.be/x5KaXXoh7XI)


The Trikala Open 2025 will be the first official competition in Greece for 2025, held in the beautiful and ultra-modern city of Trikala! At the amphitheatrically built Ananti Resort & Spa, in a hall with panoramic views of the city, Cubers of all ages and skill levels, both newcomers and veterans, from across the country and beyond, will compete for two days.
Grab your cubes, get ready, read the rules, and join us for yet another celebration of cubing!

Please read the following tabs very carefully!

Note: For a registration to be considered valid, the competitor should both register though the WCA site **AND** pay the registration fee as described in the nexts tabs.
Please read the following tabs in detail to find all the necessary information.

items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NTYyNjAsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--664f7af1cb593a99c2c06ca90444fbfb49eff7db/LOGO%20CAMPEONATO.jpg)[](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NTYyNTgsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--61d1447a942fc176de0673dc670e37b5a873f2ec/LOGO%20CAMPEONATO.jpg)

# Português

A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade.

Visando o bom andamento da competição, **ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador** nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram previstos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos, você compete; no outro, deverá ajudar a embaralhar ou sendo juiz.

**ATENÇÃO:** Competidores **menores de 16 anos devem estar acompanhadas por um responsável**. Ressaltamos que a competição ocorrerá em um espaço público, e a organização não se responsabiliza pela supervisão das crianças.

**COMPETIDORES NOVATOS** devem asssitir [a este vídeo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UHqunxu3rOU&pp=ygUPYWJyYWNtIHR1dG9yaWFs) para aprender como competir em uma competição oficial de Cubo Mágico. **Não haverá tutorial para competidores novatos no dia da competição**

As inscrições custam R$ 35,00 (trinta e cinco reais) e se encerram no dia 22 de janeiro de 2025 às 23h59min (horário local). A sua inscrição só será aceita após o cumprimento de todas as etapas de inscrição (pagamento e envio do comprovante por e-mail, com todas as informações solicitadas).

O pagamento da inscrição não dá direito a acompanhantes. Convidados e espectadores, inclusive os responsáveis por menores  de 16 anos, devem pagar uma taxa de R$ 10,00 (dez reais) para poderem ingressar no evento, preferencialmente antecipadamente.

O espaço comporta apenas 35 acompanhantes no total, de modo que reservamos 1 acompanhante por competidor. Caso você queira levar mais de 1 acompanhante, sugerimos garantir vaga do 1o acompanhante e colocar os demais na lista de espera. Ao término das inscrições, entraremos em contato informando caso sobrem vagas de acompanhantes, para que você exerça a opção de levar mais. 

Inscrições no local serão aceitas no valor de R$ 45,00 (quarenta e cinco reais), caso haja vagas.

Acompanhantes e espectadores poderão comprar seu ingresso no dia pelo valor de R$ 20,00 (vinte reais), caso haja vagas.

**Modalidade não-oficial:** Este campeonato contará com uma modalidade extra e inovadora: Skewb OH (com uma mão)

# English

Registration is open to any person, from any country.

To ensure the smooth running of the competition, **by registering for an event, you also undertake to help as a judge or scrambler** in that event (as provided by the WCA rules). In this way, the competition becomes self-sustaining, and the activities are divided among all participants, not becoming overwhelming for just a few. Each event will have at least two groups for each event. In one of the groups, you compete; in the other you should help to scramble or as a judge.

**ATTENTION:** Competitors **under 16 must be accompanied by a guardian**. Please note that the competition will take place in a public space, and the organization is not responsible for supervising children.

**FIRST TIME COMPETITORS** must watch [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UHqunxu3rOU&pp=ygUPYWJyYWNtIHR1dG9yaWFs) In order to learn how to compete in an official Rubik's Cube competition. **No tutorial for newcomers will occur at the competition**

Registration costs R$35.00 (thirty five Brazilian reais) and close on January 22, 2025 at 23:59 (local time). Your registration will only be accepted once all the registration steps have been completed (payment and sending of proof) by e-mail, with all the information required).

Payment of registration fee  does not guarantee the competitor a companion. Guests and spectators, including the guardians of people under 16, must pay a fee of R$10.00 to enter the event, preferably in advance.

The space can only hold 35 companions in total, so we reserve 1 companion per competitor. If you would like to bring more than 1 companion, we suggest that you secure a place for the 1st companion and put the others on the waiting list. At the end of registration, we'll contact you to let you know if there are any places left, so that you can choose to bring more.

On-site registrations will be accepted for R$45.00 (fourty five Brazilian reais), if there are still places.

Guests and spectators can buy their tickets on the day for R$20.00 (twenty Brazilian reais), if there are still places.

**Unofficial Event:** This competition will count with an extra and innovative event: Skewb OH (one-handed)

###### Español 
¡Bienvenidos al Ameca Nayarit 2025, la primera competencia oficial en el hermoso entorno costero y tropical de Nuevo Nayarit, y la segunda en el municipio de Bahía de Banderas! Este evento emocionante y lleno de velocidad se llevará a cabo los dias 18 y 19 de enero del 2025.

A medida que el río fluye, también lo hará la emoción de ver a los competidores resolver el cubo Rubik con asombrosa rapidez. Prepárense para estas jornadas inolvidables llenas de ingenio y velocidad.

Esta competencia es organizada por la comunidad de Vallarta Speed.

Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia de la Asociación Mundial del Cubo. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el [reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) antes de la competencia.

###### English
Welcome to the Ameca Nayarit 2025, the first official competition in the beautiful coastal and tropical environment of Nuevo Nayarit, and the second in the municipality of Bahía de Banderas! This exciting and fast-paced event will take place on January 18 and 19, 2025.

As the river flows, so will the thrill of watching competitors solve the Rubik's Cube with astonishing speed. Get ready for these unforgettable days full of ingenuity and speed.

This competition is organized by the Vallarta Speed community.

This competition is recognized as a World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with and understand the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition.

items.information:
Gdańska Liga Speedcubingu to speedcuberska inicjatywa z najdłuższymi tradycjami i niezwykłą historią. Od 2008 roku w różnych lokalizacjach nasze wspaniałe miasto gościło ponad 60 turniejów w oficjalnej formule World Cube Association, w, których łącznie wzięło udział kilka tysięcy zawodników z całego kraju.

---

Gdańsk Speedcubing League is an speedcubing initiative with long tradition and extraordinary history. Since 2008 in several different locations our city hosted more than 60 official WCA competitions, where few thousands of competitors could have done their attempts.

items.name: Chill Out Trondheim 2025
items.information:
## 🇳🇴 Informasjon
Velkommen til Chill Out Trondheim 2025! Denne konkurransen er åpen for alle som ønsker å delta.

### On The Spot Registreringer
Det vil bli mulig å registrere seg på lokalet for denne konkurransen. Dette koster 50kr og betaling vil bli gjort gjennom Vipps. Dersom du ikke har en Vipps-konto kommer vi til å tilby andre alternativer. Vi oppfordrer alle allikevel å [registrere seg på nett](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ChillOutTrondheim2025/register) for å sikre at de får plass på konkurransen.

### Førstegangsdeltakere
Førstegangsdeltakere er veldig velkommen til å delta. Det stilles ingen krav om hvor rask man må være for å delta, og vi ønsker å se flest mulig velge å delta. Vi ber alle førstegangsdeltakere vennligst lese [Førstegangsdeltakere-fanen](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ChillOutTrondheim2025#51927-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors).


---

## 🇺🇸 Information
Welcome to Chill Out Trondheim 2025! The competition is open to all who wish to compete.

### On The Spot Registration
Competitors may register on the spot for a fee of 50 NOK. The payment must be made at the time of registration and will preferaly be done though Vipps. Alternatives will be available for competitors who do not have a Vipps-account. We strongly advice all competitors to [register online](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ChillOutTrondheim2025/register) to ensure they are able to get a spot.

### First-Time Competitors
First-time competitors are very welcome to compete. There are no requirements in regards to how fast one needs to be to compete, and we would like as many people as possible to attend the competition. We would like to ask all first-time competitors to read the [First-Time Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ChillOutTrondheim2025#51927-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors) tab.

items.name: Mira Labs Cubing Scientists in Bacolod 2025
items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MzYzOTcsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--40d6a92906ae7958b380fe38d926638d59b4dabd/MIRA%20LABS%20LOGO%20COLORED.png)
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6Mzc4ODcsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--b16871971da44f65ec3100f26afb9b425073d72e/CITYMALL%20MINI%20BANNER.png)

Mira Labs is excited to announce our inaugural WCA competition, **Mira Labs Cubing Scientists in Bacolod 2025**!

This event welcomes participants of all ages and skill levels, with generous cut-off times to encourage broader participation. The 3x3x3 cube, our main event, will feature three thrilling rounds, while the 2x2x2 cube will have two rounds. To revive the community’s interest in specialized categories, we’re also offering two rounds for Clock and Square-1, while the remaining events will each feature a single, intense round.

By registering, competitors and their guests—including but not limited to family members, friends, and guardians—acknowledge that the organizing bodies, their staff, and affiliated individuals will not be liable for any injuries, loss of personal belongings, or emotional distress resulting from participation in this event.

Please be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/full/) before participating in this event.

items.information:
### On the spot registration is open for 2x2x2, 3x3x3, Pyraminx, and Skewb events only.


Kejuaraan Speedcubing Nasional untuk Indonesia pada tahun 2024. Peserta dari segala usia dan kewarganegaraan dipersilakan untuk mengikuti.
Harap diperhatikan tentang limit dan cutoff untuk setiap event, karena lebih ketat daripada kompetisi biasanya.

Akan ada **2 jenis pemenang** dalam kompetisi ini:
**Kategori Terbuka** - 3 pemenang teratas kompetisi tanpa memandang kewarganegaraan
**Kategori Indonesia** - 3 pemenang teratas yang mewakili Indonesia di setiap kategori

Peserta atau pendamping harus setuju bahwa penyelenggara, NSA, dan WCA tidak bertanggung jawab atas cedera pribadi, atau kerusakan atau kehilangan barang pribadi anda yang diakibatkan oleh partisipasi Anda dalam acara ini.
Untuk informasi lebih lanjut, silakan periksa **Persyaratan Pendaftaran.**
Biaya pendaftaran termasuk, Sertifikat Partisipasi, Lanyard, dan Name Tag.
Silahkan melakukan registrasi di website WCA dan konfirmasi di [form ini](https://forms.gle/h89T8gudSJRxWPaF9)

*Harap perhatikan jadwal selama periode pendaftaran terbuka karena dapat berubah tergantung pada jumlah orang yang mendaftar untuk setiap acara.*

---

### Registrasi OTS dibuka hanya untuk cabang 2x2x2, 3x3x3, Pyraminx, dan Skewb.

The National Speedcubing Championship for Indonesia in 2024. Competitiors of all ages and nationality are welcomed to join.
Please notice the time limit and cutoff on each events, as they are stricter than regular competitions.

There will be **2 types of winners** in this competition:
**Open Category** - Top 3 winners of the competition regardless of nationality
**Indonesian Category** - Top 3 winners representing the Indonesia in each category

Competitor or guardian must agree that the organizers, NSA and WCA shall not be liable for any personal injury, property damage or loss resulting from your participation of this event.
For more information, please check the **Registration Requirements.**
Registration fee includes, Certificate of Participation, Lanyard and Name Tag.
Please register in the WCA website and confirm your registration by filling out [this form](https://forms.gle/h89T8gudSJRxWPaF9)

items.name: Open Christmas Cube Huancayo 2024
items.information:
### **IMPORTANTE**
Es obligatorio revisar [el reglamento de la WCA.](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) para comprender las normas y procedimientos que se realizaran en el torneo.

* Revisar la pestaña [Registro](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OpenChristmasCubeHuancayo2024#50386-registro-registration) para conocer el método de registro.
* Revisar la pestaña [Horario](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OpenChristmasCubeHuancayo2024#competition-schedule) para conocer el cronograma del torneo.
* Para **Registrarte** al torneo hacer click en [Registrarse](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OpenChristmasCubeHuancayo2024/register)
* Asimismo, se les recomienda revisar estos videos para tener una noción mas clara de como se llevará a cabo el torneo.
[Cómo competir en un torneo WCA - Reglas básicas - ASA](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PFCBh3i7TiY)
[Tutorial para competidores nuevos - Jael Riggenbach](https://www.facebook.com/100000565031843/videos/3156907307906324/)
•
* Es importante escribir cuidadosamente los nombres, fecha de nacimiento o demás datos. En caso de no hacerlo de la manera correcta, serán rechazados. Para competidores que participan por segunda vez es necesario que hayan reclamado su WCA ID.

 
### **IMPORTANT**
You must check [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) to understand the rules and procedures to be followed during the tournament.

*  Check [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OpenChristmasCubeHuancayo2024#50386-registro-registration) to know the registration method.
*  Check [Schedule](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OpenChristmasCubeHuancayo2024#competition-schedule) to know the cronogram.
*   To **Register** to the competition click [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OpenChristmasCubeHuancayo2024/register)
*   We also recommend that you review this video to have a clearer notion of how the competition will be conducted.
[WCA Competitor Tutorial](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dPL3eV-A0ww)
•
* It is important to carefully write your name, birth date, and other information properly. Otherwise, your registration will not be accepted. If this is your second competition, you must have already claimed your WCA ID.

items.information:
**(Português) Brasileiro**
É com grande alegria que anunciamos mais um Capivara!

Desde o ano passados, estamos trabalhando com doações para fins filantrópicos, assim, além de nos divertirmos, também ajudamos a fazer um mundo melhor. Estamos trabalhando em conjunto com o [LEO e Lions](https://www.lionsclubs.org/) para arrecadar brinquedos e alimentos para crianças carentes, então todo o lucro da competição será revertido para essa campanha. Além disso, se você quiser fazer uma doação no dia, também será muito bem-vinda.

Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento correto, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações abaixo em "Requisitos para inscrição". Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazer neste [vídeo](https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=hfp2rKaN8jHPI_RL).

É muito importante que você conheça todo o regulamento, que podem ser lido [aqui](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian/).

Teremos premiação para todas as modalidades oficiais e premiação extra-oficial para as modalidades 'Feminino' e 'Iniciante', que tomarão como referência a classificação geral na modalidade '3x3x3'.

**English**
It is in great excitement that we announce a new Capivara!

Starting last year, we are working with donations for philanthropic purposes, therefore, in addition to having fun, we can also help make a better world. We are working together with [LEO and Lions](https://www.lionsclubs.org/) to collect toys and food to children in need, so all profit from the competition will be directed to that campaign. Besides that, if you would like to give a donation on the spot, it will also be very welcome.

Your registration will only be approved in the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information below in "Registration requirements". If you have any problem on how to register, take a look at this [video](https://youtu.be/dZQiw5v8Bm0?si=6Yf5Zun_nlTfECTy).

It is very important that you know the regulations, which may be read [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).

We will have awards for all official events, and also unofficial awards to the events 'Female' and 'Beginner', which will consider the final ranking in the '3x3x3' event.

items.information:
## VOLUNTEERING

Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8).

If any parents are willing to help judge or run, please watch the above video if you have not been a judge/runner at previous competitions. We greatly appreciate all assistance during the competition and more volunteers helping out during the competition helps to stay on schedule and not run behind.

## SPONSORSHIP

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MzgyMjcsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--d2d863a4d2dedc89e489091eae12bffb06986edb/menlyn.png)
[Menlyn Park](https://www.menlynpark.co.za) is the main host for this event. A big thank you to the events department from Menlyn Park that has gone to very far lengths to provide us with their facilities and equipment for this competition.
Menlyn Park is also providing prizes through store partners in all different categories for this event.

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MzgyMjgsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--d1f95f10cca6c70419c1d2f0af053c637d4fdb6f/Cubestuff%20Small-Photoroom.jpg)
A big thanks to [Cubestuff](https://cubestuff.co.za/) who will co host and provide prizes for this competition. They will have a stall set up at the venue for you to buy the different speedcubes they have on offer.
You can also go to Cubestuff.co.za to order a variety of cubes and equipment online.


## NOTICE FOR COMPETITORS
Please be aware that we will likely run ahead of schedule throughout the weekend. Be sure to be ready to compete in any of your scheduled events at least 30 minutes before the scheduled starting time.
To all competitors competing in the 3x3-Blinfolded event - Please be aware that the venue is located in a busy shopping centre and that there will likely be a lot of distractions during the event.


## NOTICE OF FILMING

Please note that there will be filming and photography at this event. You therefore consent to your image being used by CubingZA and its partners in their marketing and social media platforms by attending.


#### About CubingZA

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6Mzc4NzgsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--32984d244f55e182cf16e089cf3f8466caffc2ac/image.png)



CubingZA is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country.

If you'd be interested in helping out in CubingZA's mission to improve competitive speedcubing in the country, [please get in touch.](https://cubingza.org/contact)

Hay un límite de 40 competidores para el registro.

* Los competidores tienen que estar presentes y listos para competir cuando se los llama, de no ser así, se penalizará al competidor con la descalificación de la categoría, de acuerdo con el artículo [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) del Reglamento de la WCA.

[![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcGd3IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--413963af1d32608ec1038d304a181c8adedb8510/SpeedcubingCanadaLogo-724.png)](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/)

## [EN]

### Please be quiet

All of the events at this competition are ***blindfolded events***, which require a significant amount of learning, practice and concentration. All attendees, including competitors and guests, are asked to please remain quiet at this competition to allow competitors to concentrate.

### Note for new competitors

Although first-timers are welcome to compete if they know how to solve puzzles blindfolded (please note Regulation [2k6](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2k6)), this might not be the best experience for new competitors. Please consider registering for [another competition](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=Canada) if this one isn't for you.

### Registration Reminders

You must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations will not be accepted. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details.

### Competitor Requirements

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors should be familiar with the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). For a summary of the most important regulations, please refer to the following resources: [WCA Competition Tutorial](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/edudoc/competitor-tutorial/tutorial.pdf) & [The basics of an official WCA competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vz1V0Gv0qX0). 

If you are a new competitor, this video expains what to expect at your first competition: [What to expect at your first competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xK2ycvTfgUY). Please see tabs for more information about the competition.

### Mailing List

Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements.

### Notice of Filming and Photography

Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

## [FR]

### Silence s'il vous plaît

Toutes les épreuves de cette compétition sont des épreuves ***avec les yeux bandés***, qui nécessitent une quantité importante d'apprentissage, d'entraînement et de concentration. Toutes les personnes présentes, y compris les participants et les accompagnateurs, sont priées de ne pas faire de bruit afin de permettre aux participants de se concentrer.

### Note pour les nouveaux compétiteurs

Bien que les novices soient les bienvenus s'ils savent résoudre des casse-tête les yeux bandés (voir le règlement [2k6](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2k6)) ou le défi des moindres mouvements (3x3 Résolution optimisée), il se peut que cette compétition ne soit pas la meilleure expérience pour les nouveaux compétiteurs. Veuillez envisager de vous inscrire à [une autre compétition](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=Canada) si celle-ci ne vous convient pas.

### Rappels concernant l'inscription

Vous devez vous inscrire *et payer les frais d'inscription* avant que votre inscription ne soit acceptée. Les inscriptions non payées ne seront pas acceptées. Voir les sections **Liste des compétiteurs** et **Liste d'attente** au bas de cette page pour plus de détails.

### Exigences pour les compétiteurs

Cette compétition est reconnue comme une compétition officielle de la World Cube Association. Par conséquent, tous les compétiteurs doivent être familiers avec les [règlements de la WCA] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). Pour un résumé des règlements les plus importants, veuillez vous référer aux ressources suivantes: [WCA Competition Tutorial](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/edudoc/competitor-tutorial/tutorial.pdf) & [The basics of an official WCA competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vz1V0Gv0qX0) (des sous-titres en français disponibles). 

Pour les nouveaux compétiteurs, cette vidéo explique à quoi s'attendre lors de votre première compétition: [What to expect at your first competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xK2ycvTfgUY) (des sous-titres en français disponibles). Veuillez consulter les onglets pour plus d'informations sur la compétition.

### Liste de diffusion

Veuillez suivre [Speedcubing Canada] (https://speedcubingcanada.org/fr)  sur les réseaux sociaux et/ou [vous inscrire à notre liste de diffusion](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) pour vous tenir au courant des annonces de compétitions.

### Avis de droit à l'image

Les participants aux compétitions de Speedcubing Canada consentent à ce que leurs images soient utilisées par Speedcubing Canada et ses partenaires dans de cadre de la promotion de ses activités notamment sur les réseaux sociaux et autres plateformes numériques.

**ESPAÑOL**
El amor por los cubos va más allá de solo resolver un rompecabezas; es una pasión que desafía la mente, agudiza la concentración y une a personas con el mismo entusiasmo. En la competencia Yollotl Tlaxcala 2024, te invitamos a ser parte de esta experiencia única, donde no solo pondrás a prueba tu habilidad y velocidad, sino que también compartirás momentos inolvidables con una comunidad vibrante de cuberos.
Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia oficial de la Asociación Mundial de Cubos. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el [reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) antes de la competencia.

**English**
The love for cubes goes beyond just solving a puzzle; it's a passion that challenges the mind, sharpens focus, and brings together people who share the same enthusiasm. At the Yollotl Tlaxcala 2024 competition, we invite you to be part of this unique experience, where you'll not only test your skill and speed but also share unforgettable moments with a vibrant community of cubers.
This competition is recognized as an official competition of the World Cube Association. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with and understand the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) prior to competition.

###### Español 
¡Bienvenidos al Coralito Bahía De Banderas 2024, la tercera competencia oficial en el hermoso estado de Nayarit y primera en el municipio de Bahía de Banderas!. Este evento emocionante y lleno de velocidad se llevará a cabo en la ciudad de La Cruz de Huanacaxtle los días 9 y 10 de noviembre de 2024.

El Coralito Bahía De Banderas 2024 reunirá a cuberos de todo el estado de Nayarit y más allá, brindándoles la oportunidad de mostrar su destreza y competir en una variedad de modalidades y categorías. Tanto si eres un principiante como un profesional experimentado, este torneo ofrece una oportunidad para que todos participen y se diviertan.

Esta competencia es organizada por el Team Nayarit y la comunidad Vallarta Speed.

Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia de la Asociación Mundial del Cubo. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el [reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) antes de la competencia.

###### English
Welcome to Coralito Bahía De Banderas 2024, the third official competition in the beautiful state of Nayarit and the first one in the municipality of Bahía de Banderas! This exciting and fast-paced event will take place in the city of La Cruz de Huanacaxtle on November 9th and 10th, 2024.

The Coralito Bahía De Banderas will bring together cubers from all over the state of Nayarit and beyond, providing them with the opportunity to showcase their skills and compete in a variety of events and categories. Whether you're a beginner or a seasoned pro, this tournament offers a chance for everyone to participate and have fun.

This competition is organized by Team Nayarit and the Vallarta Speed community.

This competition is recognized as a World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with and understand the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition.

Els socis de l'ACSC reben un descompte del 15% després de la competició. Pots fer-te soci de l'ACSC [aquí](https://linktr.ee/speedcubingcat).

Aquesta competició no té una categoria principal. El guanyador de la competició es decidirà mitjançant el “Sum of Ranks”. Això consisteix a sumar totes les posicions en què ha quedat un competidor a totes les categories, i qui obtingui el nombre més baix serà qui millor ha actuat en tot el llarg de la competició i, per tant, el guanyador.
​
Los socios de la ACSC reciben un descuento del 15% después de la competición. Puedes hacerte socio de la ACSC [aquí](https://linktr.ee/speedcubingcat).

Esta competición no tiene una categoría principal. El ganador de la competición se decidirá mediante “Sum of Ranks”. Esto consiste a sumar todas las posiciones en que ha quedado un competidor en todas las categorías, y quién obtenga el número más bajo será quien mejor ha actuado a lo largo de toda la competición y, por tanto, el ganador.
​
The ACSC members will receive a 15% discount after the end of the competition. You can become a member of the ACSC [here](https://linktr.ee/speedcubingcat).

This competition does not have a main event. The winner of the competition will be decided through the “Sum of Ranks”. This consists of adding all the positions in which a competitor has remained in all categories, and the one who obtain the lowest number will be the one who has performed best throughout the competition and, therefore, the winner.

items.name: Rubik's UK Championship 2024
items.information:
## Welcome to Rubik's UK Championship 2024!
### This year's UK National Championship!

#### Please read ALL tabs before registering.

##### Spectators are welcome! Please read the information below, and the information in the [Guests, Spectators, and Media](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RubiksUKChampionship2024#41928-guests-spectators-and-media) tab.

**Free T-Shirt:** By registering and attending Rubik's UK Championship 2024, you'll receive a Rubik's UK Championship 2024 T-shirt as a memento! **Please fill in your registration comment with your T-shirt size.**


**Guests:** A fee of £5 for a guest wristband will be due for all spectators and competitors' guests. They will be available on the door, payable via cash or card. Competitors will receive lanyards, and their guests and spectators will receive wristbands, which are to be worn throughout the weekend for security reasons. **This includes parents/guardians of competitors.** Please note that the guest field in the registration form is for informational purposes only.

**Newcomers:** Unfortunately, **this competition is not open to first-time competitors**. If you have not been to a competition before but would like to attend this one, you must attend another competition first. You can see all upcoming UK competitions [here](https://wca.ukca.org).

**Qualification Requirements:** If you do not meet the qualification requirements outlined in the [Events tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RubiksUKChampionship2024#competition-events) in an official WCA competition by October 22nd you will not be eligible to compete in those events. You will not be able to add events to your registration which you do not qualify for, but can update your registration if you later qualify for them. Please note that **the only qualification for 2x2, 3x3, Pyraminx, and Skewb is to have any average in the event.**

**Final Round Advancements:** For all events with more than one round, we will be taking a minimum number of UK competitors to the final. If necessary, we will increase the size of the final by one competitor at a time until we have enough UK competitors. The requirements are as follows: 2x2, 4x4, 5x5, 6x6, 7x7, 3x3 Blindfolded, 3x3 One-Handed, Clock, Megaminx, Pyraminx, Skewb, Square-1: 6 UK competitors; 3x3: 8 UK competitors. 3x3 Multiple Blindfolded has a Top 16 qualification requirement, similarly this must contain at least 6 UK competitors.

**Fewest Moves:** FMC will **not** be held at this competition. To compete for the national champion title for FMC, you must compete at [Rubik's UK Championship FMC 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RubiksUKChampionshipFMC2024). The winner of the FMC competition will be awarded their prize during the awards at Rubik's UK Championship 2024.

**Please Note:** As this is the UK National Championship, only competitors who represent the United Kingdom will be eligible for prizes. The competition remains open for all nationalities to compete.

**Cena kotizacije za ovo takmičenje zavisi od toga koje discipline slažete. Ukoliko se takmičite samo u 3x3 i 2x2 kocki cena kotizacije iznosi 1,000RSD , ali ukoliko se takmičite u više disciplina plaćate punu cenu od 2,000RSD. Ovo nije standardna praksa i ovo pravilo važi samo za ovo takmičenje.**

------------------------

(ENG)

Belgrade Open 2024 is the 22nd speedcubing competition in a row that's being held in Serbia. Anyone can participate, no matter which nationality or age they are, but they need to be familiar with the WCA Regulations and read them before the competition.

**Registration fee for this competition depends on which events you are competing in. If you are competing in only 3x3 and 2x2 cubes, you will pay 1,000RSD, but if you are competing in more events, you will pay the full amount of 2,000RSD. This is not a standard practice, and this rule applies only to this competition.**

##**[FR]**

Il n'y aura **aucun remboursement au-delà de la date de fin des inscriptions**. Si vous vous inscrivez et que vous n'êtes finalement pas en mesure de venir, merci de nous en informer rapidement, afin de laisser la chance à quelqu'un d'autre de participer. Vous serez remboursé si vous êtes toujours sur la liste d'attente à la fin de la période d'inscription. Lisez attentivement, ci-bas, toutes les conditions d'inscription avant de vous inscrire.

*Si vous étudiez au Cégep Trois-Rivières, écrivez votre numéro matricule dans les commentaires de votre inscription*.

Le déroulement de la compétition pourra vous paraître lent, car certaines limites de temps sont élevées.

Consultez les autres onglets pour des informations additionnelles très importantes sur la compétition.

*Note : Certains textes dans ce site web sont en anglais uniquement. Veuillez nous en excuser car les organisateurs ne peuvent faire autrement en utilisant ce site web*.

###**Avis de droit à l'image**

Les participants aux compétitions de Speedcubing Canada consentent à ce que leur image soit utilisée par Speedcubing Canada et ses partenaires dans de cadre de la promotion de ses activités notamment sur les réseaux sociaux et sur d'autres plateformes numériques.


##**[EN]**

There will be **no refunds after the registration period closes**. If you register and you are not able to come, please let us know as soon as possible to let someone else have a chance to participate. You will be refunded if you are still on the waiting list when the registration period closes. Please read all the terms and conditions below carefully before registering.

*If you study at Cégep Trois-Rivières, please enter your matricule number in the comments of your registration*.

The pace of the competition may seem slow to you, as some time limits are high.

See the other tabs for very important additional information about the competition.

###**Notice of Filming and Photography**

Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their image being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

items.name: Kyub sa Aga Masskara 2024
items.information:
**US (English)** 
The Negros Speedcubers Organizing Committee is thrilled to present the **Kyub sa Masskara 2024** competition series, two competitions held in one day—morning and afternoon, in celebration of the Masskara Festival in Bacolod City!

This competition will be held in the morning, the afternoon competition can be found [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KyubsaHaponMasskara2024/register).

Competitors **shall only compete in one of the two competitions**, either [Kyub sa Aga](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KyubsaAgaMasskara2024) or [Kyub sa Hapon](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KyubsaHaponMasskara2024). This is strictly implemented. We strongly encourage you to stay 'til the end of both competitions as there will be awards.

All events in both competitions are the same and will consist of a single round. For more details about the competition, please refer to the tabs above.

By registering, competitors and their guests—including but not limited to family members, friends, and guardians—acknowledge and agree that the organizing bodies, their personnel, and any associated individuals shall not be held liable for any harm or injury, loss of personal belongings or property, or emotional distress resulting from participation in this competition.

Please be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/full/) before participating in this event.

***

**PH (Tagalog)**
Ikinagagalag na hinahandog ng Negros Speedcubers Organizing Committee ang **Kyub sa Masskara 2024** kompetisyong serye, dalawang kompetisyon na gaganapin sa isang araw—umaga at hapon, bilang pagdiriwang ng Masskara Festival sa Lungsod ng Bacolod!

Ang kompetisyong ito ay magaganap sa umaga. Ang hapong edisyon ay makikita [dito](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KyubsaHaponMasskara2024).

Ang mga kalahok ay **dapat na makilahok sa isang kompetisyon lamang**, maaring [Kyub sa Aga](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KyubsaAgaMasskara2024) o [Kyub sa Hapon](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KyubsaHaponMasskara2024). Ito ay mahigpitang ipinapatupad.

Ang lahat ng kategorya sa dalawang kompetisyon ay magkapareho at binubuo ng isang round lamang. Para sa karagdagang impormasyon sa kompetisyon, maaring i-klik ang mga tabs sa itaas.

Sa pamamagitan ng pagrerehistro, ang mga kalahok at kanilang mga bisita—kabilang ngunit hindi limitado sa mga miyembro ng pamilya, kaibigan, at mga tagapag-alaga—ay kinikilala at sumasang-ayon na ang mga namamahalang katawan, kanilang mga tauhan, at anumang kaugnay na indibidwal ay hindi mananagot para sa anumang pinsala o sakuna, pagkawala ng personal na pag-aari o kagamitan, o emosyonal na pagkabalisa na resulta ng paglahok sa kompetisyon na ito.

Maging pamilyar sa [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/full/) bago makilahok sa kompetisyong ito.

***

**PH (Hiligaynon)**
Bugal nga gina-anunsyo Negros Speedcubers Organizing Committee ang **Kyub sa Masskara 2024**, duha ka kompetisyon nga gina hiwat sa isa ka adlaw—aga kag hapon, para i-selebrar ang maabot nga Masskara Festival sa syudad sang Bacolod.

Hiliwaton ang kompetisyon nga ini sa aga. Ang hapon nga edisyon, makita [diri](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KyubsaHaponMasskara2024).

Sa mga maintra, **isa lang dapat ka kompetisyon ang intrahan**, pwede nga [Kyub sa Aga](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KyubsaAgaMasskara2024) ukon [Kyub sa Hapon](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KyubsaHaponMasskara2024). Ini ang strikto nga gina sunod.

Ang tanan nga kategorya sa duha nga kompetisyon parehas lang kag ginalakipan sang isa ka round. Para sa mas madamo pa gid nga impormasyon, palihog i-klik ang mga tabs sa babaw.

Paagi sa pagrehistro, ang mga maintra kag ang ila mga kaupod—lakip na apang indi limitado sa mga miyembro sang pamilya, abyan, kag mga tagabantay—nagasugot kag nagakilala nga ang mga nagadumala, ila mga personnel, kag bisan ano nga may kaangtanan nga mga indibidwal indi manabat para sa bisan ano nga samad o aksidente, pagkadula sang personal nga gamit, ukon emosyonal nga kasakit nga resulta sang pag-apil sa sini nga kompetisyon.

Maging pamilyar sa [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/full/) antis mag-intra sa kompetisyon nga ini.

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MzU0ODMsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--c50c26c64cb1b9f822467f54be10667c701e1a75/Untitled%20design%20(14).png)

**Atenção:** Esta competição terá limite de competitores. Inscreva-se somente se você tem **certeza que irá participar**. 
Em caso de desistência, por favor **entrar em contato com a organização**.

Pagamento da taxa via PIX: matcasvia@gmail.com

Enviar comprovante para o e-mail: matcasvia@gmail.com 
Envie o comprovante com o nome do competidor.
Para inscrições no local, favor levar documento que comprove sua identidade.

**Aviso**: Ao se inscrever para a competição, você automaticamente se disponibiliza para atuar como juiz, runner e/ou embaralhador quando solicitado. A recusa não justificada poderá acarretar em desclaificação (DNF) de um ou mais eventos de acordo com a regra [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2).

In case of withdrawal, please **contact the organization**.

Payment with PIX method: matcasvia@gmail.com

Send the payment proof to E-mail: matcasvia@gmail.com 
Send the proof with the competitor's name.
To register on site, please bring a document that proves your identity.

**Warning:** By registering for the competition, you automatically make yourself available to act as a judge, runner and/or scrambler when requested. Les participants aux compétitions de Speedcubing Canada consentent à ce que leurs images soient utilisées par Speedcubing Canada et ses partenaires dans de cadre de la promotion de ses activités notamment sur les réseaux sociaux et autres plateformes numériques.

---

This is the first-ever Quebec Championship organized by [Speedcubing Canada](https://speedcubingcanada.org).

13 official WCA events (all events except 4x4x4 Blindfolded, 5x5x5 Blindfolded, 3x3x3 Multi-Blind, and 3x3x3 Fewest Moves) will be held at this competition.

Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

##Português

**Atenção:** Esta competição terá limite de competitores. Inscreva-se somente se você tem **certeza que irá participar**. 
Em caso de desistência, por favor **entrar em contato com a organização**.

Pagamento da taxa via PIX: matcasvia@gmail.com

Enviar comprovante para o e-mail: matcasvia@gmail.com 
Envie o comprovante com o nome do competidor.
Sócios do Clube Aquático da Aclimação terão 50% de desconto na inscrição e terão de informar no campo de comentários que são sócios e comprovar no dia da competição.
Para inscrições no local, favor levar documento que comprove sua identidade.

**Aviso**: Ao se inscrever para a competição, você automaticamente se disponibiliza para atuar como juiz, runner e/ou embaralhador quando solicitado. A recusa não justificada poderá acarretar em desclaificação (DNF) de um ou mais eventos de acordo com a regra [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2).

##English

**Attention:** This competition will have a limit of competitors. Sign up only if you are **sure you will attend**.
In case of withdrawal, please **contact the organization**.

Payment with PIX method: matcasvia@gmail.com

Send the payment proof to E-mail: matcasvia@gmail.com 
Send the proof with the competitor's name.
Members of the Aclimação Aquatic Club will have a 50% discount on registration and will have to inform in the comments field that they are members and prove it on the day of the competition.
To register on site, please bring a document that proves your identity.

**Warning:** By registering for the competition, you automatically make yourself available to act as a judge, runner and/or scrambler when requested. Unjustified refusal may result in disqualification (DNF) of one or more events according to rule [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2).

**Προσοχή:** Ο διαγωνισμός αυτός είναι το Α μέρος σειράς δύο διαγωνισμών. Μπορείτε να συμμετάσχετε **μόνο σε έναν από τους δύο**. 
Ο 3x3 είναι και στους δύο διαγωνισμούς οπότε διαλέξτε με προσοχή ποια μέρα ή πoιο από τα 4x4 και Clock ή 2x2 και OH επιθυμείτε.

Μετά από τις διακοπές θα βρεθούμε ξανά για τον πρώτο διαγωνισμό της νέας σεζόν! Ελάτε να περάσουμε όμορφα για ακόμα μία φορά στον γνωστό πλέον χώρο του Rubicon. Σας περιμένουμε στο **Autumn Cubing Reunion Athens 2024 - A. **

Αγωνίσματα Α' διαγωνισμού:
* 3x3
* 4x4
* Clock

Παρακαλoύμε διαβάστε αναλυτικά τις επόμενες σελίδες για να βρείτε όλες τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες. 

Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείται ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί το registration στο σελίδα του διαγωνισμού στην WCA **KAI** να γίνει και η πληρωμή του αντιτίμου συμμετοχής με χρήση της τραπεζικής σας κάρτας μέσω της πλατφόρμας πληρωμών stripe που χρησιμοποιεί η WCA, όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα. 

[Εγγραφή στη WCA, σε επίσημο διαγωνισμό και πολλά ακόμα. Οδηγός για πρωτάρηδες.](https://youtu.be/RS768gK0Vrg)

[Πώς να είσαι κριτής σε διαγωνισμό κύβων του Ρούμπικ.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=x5KaXXoh7XI)

**Note:** This competition is part A of a series of two competitions. You can participate in **only one of the two**. 
3x3 is in both contests so choose carefully which day or which of 4x4 and Clock or 2x2 and OH you prefer.

After the holidays we will meet again for the first competition of the new season! Come and have a good time once again at the famous Rubicon venue. We are waiting for you in **Autumn Cubing Reunion Athens 2024 - A.**

Competition Α events:
* 3x3
* 4x4
* Clock

## [EN]

### Registration Reminders

Since this is a "favourites" competition, **you may choose at most four (4) events**. 

You must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations will not be accepted. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details.

### Competitor Requirements

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors should be familiar with the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). For a summary of the most important regulations, please refer to the following resources: [WCA Competition Tutorial](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/edudoc/competitor-tutorial/tutorial.pdf) & [The basics of an official WCA competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vz1V0Gv0qX0).

If you are a new competitor, this video expains what to expect at your first competition: [What to expect at your first competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xK2ycvTfgUY). Please see tabs for more information about the competition.

### Mailing List

Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements.

### Notice of Filming and Photography

Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

## [FR]

### Rappels concernant l'inscription

Comme il s'agit là d'une compétition de type "favoris", **vous pouvez choisir au maximum quatre (4) épreuves**. 

Vous devez vous inscrire *et payer les frais d'inscription* avant que votre inscription ne soit acceptée. Les inscriptions non payées ne seront pas acceptées. Voir les sections **Liste des compétiteurs** et **Liste d'attente** au bas de cette page pour plus de détails.

### Exigences pour les compétiteurs

Cette compétition est reconnue comme une compétition officielle de la World Cube Association. Par conséquent, tous les compétiteurs doivent être familiers avec les [règlements de la WCA] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). Pour un résumé des règlements les plus importants, veuillez vous référer aux ressources suivantes: [WCA Competition Tutorial](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/edudoc/competitor-tutorial/tutorial.pdf) & [The basics of an official WCA competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vz1V0Gv0qX0) (des sous-titres en français disponibles).

Pour les nouveaux compétiteurs, cette vidéo explique à quoi s'attendre lors de votre première compétition: [What to expect at your first competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xK2ycvTfgUY) (des sous-titres en français disponibles). Veuillez consulter les onglets pour plus d'informations sur la compétition.

### Liste de diffusion

Veuillez suivre [Speedcubing Canada] (https://speedcubingcanada.org/fr)  sur les réseaux sociaux et/ou [vous inscrire à notre liste de diffusion](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) pour vous tenir au courant des annonces de compétitions.

### Avis de droit à l'image

Les participants aux compétitions de Speedcubing Canada consentent à ce que leurs images soient utilisées par Speedcubing Canada et ses partenaires dans de cadre de la promotion de ses activités notamment sur les réseaux sociaux et autres plateformes numériques.
